subject: literacy
concept: Writing a full critical literary essay analyzing form, social context, and an original interpretation, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their essay using a thesis/form-analysis/context-analysis/evidence organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a full critical essay combining formal analysis, social/historical context, and an original interpretive thesis

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay presents a clear original thesis supported by formal analysis, contextual understanding, and specific textual evidence
misconception_flags: essay restates plot or a known interpretation rather than presenting an original, evidence-supported thesis

interest_binding: text generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
